QuestInfo.name: Edelstein Dispatch Report
QuestInfo.0: That's it for the Edelstein Dispatch mission. All that's left now is to report back to #bNeinheart#k.
QuestInfo.1: You are reporting to #bNeinheart#k at the moment. Continue the conversation.
QuestInfo.2: The Edelstein Dispatch mission is over and you have reported everything to #bNeinheart#k in Ereve. #bNeinheart#k said the power of Empress is still incomplete, and that they need a power that could counter the Black Wings's 'Resurrection'. He also wants to make peace with the #bResistance#k as soon as possible.

0.0: You're looking kind of worn out. Do you think you can handle bringing the report back to Ereve?\r\n#L0##b(Report back to Neinheart.)#l\n#k
0.1: So you weren't popular with the citizens of Edelstein, boo hoo. Get used to it. People aren't always going to like you. I'm certainly on the fence. \r\n#L0##bYou really know how to dish out the comfort, you know that, Neinheart?#l\n#k
0.2:
(He smiles faintly.) 
Part of a knight's job is to learn how to deal with animosity, especially when it's justified.
#L0##bWait, does that mean we were responsible for what happened to Edelstein? I heard the incident was unavoidable!#l
#k
0.3: That doesn't matter. To the Resistance, it was our fault. And until they forgive us, we will bear that responsibility gracefully. #rRemember, a flower will never bloom if you're afraid to get mud on your boots.#k\r\n#L0##bThat's, um, quite philosophical.#l\n#k
0.4: #bMihile#k and I have talked philosophy long into many a night! #bHawkeye#k calls it hogwash, in his usual polite manner, of course... But yes, I do have my philosophical moments.

yes.0: #b#h0##k, you have the most stunned expression on your face. Your mission was a success! Celebrate while you can! The future may not be so easy.

no.0: Let me know when you are ready to conclude your report.

1.0: Our #bEmpress#k still cannot fully control the powers she has from Shinsoo. That means, your power is also unstable, since Cygnus Knights are fueled by #bher#k blessings. Our enemies grow strong, and their experiment troubles me.
1.1: Our fight with the #bBlack Wings#k has only just begun. Darkness is falling. We must #e#rbe prepared.#k#n\r\nIf we can make amends with the #bResistance#k as well, so much the better. \r\n

yes.0: #b#h0##k, continue to grow. The Empress is counting on you.
